To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the combined Box-Jenkins models and exponential smoothing models are the best choice for the analysis and forecasting of the indicators under study from mobile telecom area.
the combined models have a higher level of forecasting success compared to the individual models.
the exponential smoothing methods are not very suitable for time series analysis and extrapolation of selected indicators from mobile telecom area.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a comparative analysis of the exponential smoothing models and ARIMA models in time series analysis from the telecom area.
the application of combined models for the modelling and forecasting of selected indicators from telecom area.
an application of both the exponential smoothing models and the Box-Jenkins models for modelling of past developments and forecasting of the indicators from the mobile telecom sector.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
both groups of models are applicable in the area of analysis under study.
it is possible to apply both types of models for time series analysis and extrapolation forecasting from the telecom area.
the combined models are recommended for time series analysis and extrapolation in the telecom area.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the exponential smoothing methods and the ARIMA methods are suitable for time series analysis and extrapolation forecasting.
the combined models are the most appropriate for modelling and forecasting the indicators from mobile telecom area.
the exponential smoothing methods are more appropriate for the indicators under study from telecom area than the Box-Jenkins models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Box-Jenkins models are more appropriate for the analysis of the indicators from the telecom sector.
the combined models can be recommended for modelling and forecasting of selected indicators in the telecom area.
the combined model, in the case of the indicators from the mobile telecom market, is the ARIMA(2, 1, 1)(1, 0, 0)12 model, which was selected from the group of ARIMA models.
